The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) Specialist / Senior Non-Functional Test Engineer with strong automation expertise to lead and elevate non-functional quality across enterprise banking platforms. This role demands deep technical and domain expertise, ownership of NFR strategy, and the ability to drive cross-team alignment on performance, resilience, security, and observability outcomes. Operating in an offshore (India) model, the role requires high autonomy, leadership through influence, and the ability to deliver audit-ready, measurable results at scale.

 

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Lead non-functional testing and engineering initiatives across performance, resilience, security, usability, and observability domains.
  • Design and implement advanced performance engineering practices, including workload modeling, benchmarking, capacity planning, and system tuning recommendations.
  • Must have automation & test engineering maturity, should be able to build scalable NFR test frameworks and components using Java or TypeScript, following “Test as Code” principles with reusable and standardized assets
  • Drive resilience engineering through failure experiments, recovery validation, and robustness verification across distributed systems.
  • Oversee security test engineering aligned with OWASP Top 10, including misconfiguration detection and validation of security controls, along with interpretation of DAST/SAST outputs.
  • Establish repeatable usability and accessibility validation practices aligned with WCAG standards, ensuring evidence-based quality checks.
  • Define and validate observability and operability readiness, including SLIs/SLOs, alert effectiveness, and runbook completeness.
  • Build scalable NFR test frameworks and components using Java or TypeScript, following “Test as Code” principles with reusable and standardized assets.
  • Lead CI/CD integration of NFR validation with threshold management, trend-based gating, flakiness control, and environment-aware execution.
  • Define and govern NFR requirements, ensuring measurable criteria, validation strategies, and audit-ready evidence standards.
  • Drive advanced root cause analysis across teams using logs, metrics, traces, and code-level insights, ensuring closure and validation of fixes.
  • Own and structure NFR validation using Jira (Xray), including test design, execution tracking, reporting, and KPI measurement.
  • Act as a remote lead by aligning stakeholders, preparing decision-ready materials, and ensuring seamless collaboration across time zones.
  • Proactively identify risks, provide impact analysis, and define mitigation strategies with clear recommendations.
  • Standardize NFR approaches across teams through templates, frameworks, and reusable best practices while mentoring and coaching team members.

 

Skills and attributes for success

  • Must-Have
    • Strong banking domain knowledge, including core banking processes and channels.
    • Broad understanding of technology across all layers (UI/browser, APIs, services, databases, networking, IAM, proxies/WAF).
    • Extensive hands-on experience in non-functional testing across performance, resilience, security, usability, and observability.
    • Automation capability with Java or TypeScript (Python optional) and experience with Test-as-Code practices.
    • Experience integrating NFR checks into CI/CD pipelines with quality gates and monitoring.
    • Strong analytical and debugging skills for root cause identification and performance optimization.
    • Expertise in defining measurable NFR criteria, designing tests, and ensuring traceability with supporting evidence.
    • Experience using Jira (Xray) for test management and reporting.
  • Beneficial
    • Experience with Temenos or similar core banking platforms and integration patterns.
    • Strong expertise across multiple tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Rest Assured, K6, JMeter, Gatling, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, Tempo/Loki, and Tableau.
    • Experience in defining enterprise-level performance, resilience, and security strategies.
    • Experience in coaching teams or leading communities of practice to enhance NFR maturity.
  • Soft Skills
    • Strong leadership through influence, aligning cross-functional teams without formal authority.
    • High ownership mindset with proactive risk identification and mitigation planning.
    • Excellent communication skills, especially in high-pressure scenarios such as incidents or task forces.
    • Mentorship mindset with a focus on enabling teams through reusable assets, standards, and coaching.
    • Strong stakeholder management skills across engineering, product, leadership, and audit functions.
  • Delivery Expectations
    • This role is staffed in client location in Chennai, India (offshore).
    • Operate as a highly independent owner of NFR workstreams in an offshore environment.
    • Drive end-to-end outcomes without reliance on detailed instructions or micromanagement.
    • Proactively escalate risks with supporting evidence, impact assessment, and clear recommendations.
